values.content:
={{ `You are an invoice data extraction system for ProcureGuard AI.

Your job is to extract structured procurement data from supplier invoice text.

IMPORTANT RULES:
1. Extract only information explicitly present in the invoice.
2. Never invent or guess missing values.
3. If a field is missing, return null.
4. Monetary values must be numbers only, without commas or currency symbols.
5. Quantities must be numbers.
6. Convert invoice_date to YYYY-MM-DD when the date can be determined unambiguously.
7. Preserve SKU/product codes exactly as written.
8. Return ONLY valid JSON.
9. Do not include Markdown.
10. Do not include explanations.
11. Do not wrap the JSON in code fences.
12. Every invoice line item must appear in the items array.

Return exactly this structure:

{
  "supplier_name": null,
  "supplier_code": null,
  "invoice_number": null,
  "po_number": null,
  "invoice_date": null,
  "currency": null,
  "subtotal": null,
  "tax": null,
  "discount": null,
  "additional_charges": null,
  "total": null,
  "items": [
    {
      "description": null,
      "supplier_sku": null,
      "quantity": null,
      "unit_price": null,
      "line_total": null
    }
  ]
}

INVOICE TEXT:

${$json.text}` }}

parameters.query:
SELECT
    id,
    organization_id,
    supplier_code,
    supplier_name,
    email,
    status
FROM public.suppliers
WHERE supplier_code = $1
  AND status = 'ACTIVE'
LIMIT 1;

SELECT po.*
FROM public.purchase_orders po
WHERE po.po_number = $1
  AND po.supplier_id = $2
  AND po.organization_id = $3
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    poi.id AS po_item_id,
    poi.line_number,
    poi.product_id,
    poi.description_from_po,
    poi.ordered_quantity,
    poi.unit_price AS po_unit_price,
    poi.discount AS po_discount,
    poi.tax AS po_tax,
    poi.line_total AS po_line_total,
    poi.received_quantity,
    p.*
FROM public.purchase_order_items poi
JOIN public.products p
    ON p.id = poi.product_id
   AND p.organization_id = poi.organization_id
WHERE poi.purchase_order_id = $1
ORDER BY poi.line_number ASC;

SELECT
    sp.*,
    p.sku AS internal_sku,
    p.product_name AS internal_product_name
FROM public.supplier_products sp
JOIN public.products p
    ON p.id = sp.product_id
   AND p.organization_id = sp.organization_id
WHERE sp.supplier_id = $1
  AND sp.organization_id = $2
ORDER BY p.sku;

SELECT
    pa.*,
    p.sku AS internal_sku,
    p.product_name AS internal_product_name
FROM public.product_aliases pa
JOIN public.products p
    ON p.id = pa.product_id
   AND p.organization_id = pa.organization_id
WHERE pa.organization_id = $1
  AND pa.supplier_id = $2
  AND pa.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY p.sku;

SELECT
    $1::uuid AS organization_id,
    $2::uuid AS supplier_id,
    $3::uuid AS purchase_order_id,
    $4::date AS invoice_date,

    $5::uuid AS invoice_id,
    $6::uuid AS invoice_item_id,

    $7::integer AS invoice_line_number,
    $8::text AS invoice_supplier_sku,
    $9::text AS invoice_description,
    $10::numeric AS invoice_quantity,
    $11::numeric AS invoice_unit_price,
    $12::numeric AS invoice_line_total,

    p.id AS product_id,
    p.sku AS internal_sku,
    p.product_name AS internal_product_name,

    poi.id AS po_item_id,
    poi.line_number AS po_line_number,
    poi.description_from_po,
    poi.ordered_quantity,
    poi.unit_price AS po_unit_price,

    sp.supplier_sku AS mapped_supplier_sku,
    sp.agreed_unit_price,
    sp.tolerance_percent,

    pa.alias_name,
    pa.normalized_alias,
    pa.confidence_score

FROM public.products p

JOIN public.purchase_order_items poi
    ON poi.product_id = p.id
    AND poi.organization_id = p.organization_id
    AND poi.purchase_order_id = $3::uuid

LEFT JOIN public.supplier_products sp
    ON sp.product_id = p.id
    AND sp.organization_id = p.organization_id
    AND sp.supplier_id = $2::uuid
    AND sp.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND sp.effective_from <= $4::date
    AND (
        sp.effective_to IS NULL
        OR sp.effective_to >= $4::date
    )

LEFT JOIN public.product_aliases pa
    ON pa.product_id = p.id
    AND pa.organization_id = p.organization_id
    AND pa.supplier_id = $2::uuid
    AND pa.status = 'ACTIVE'

WHERE p.organization_id = $1::uuid
  AND p.status = 'ACTIVE'

ORDER BY poi.line_number;

WITH invoice_input AS (
    SELECT
        $1::uuid AS organization_id,
        $2::uuid AS supplier_id,
        $3::uuid AS purchase_order_id,
        $4::date AS invoice_date,

        $5::uuid AS invoice_id,
        $6::uuid AS invoice_item_id,

        $7::integer AS invoice_line_number,
        $8::text AS invoice_supplier_sku,
        $9::text AS invoice_description,
        $10::numeric AS invoice_quantity,
        $11::numeric AS invoice_unit_price,
        $12::numeric AS invoice_line_total
),

catalog_match AS (
    SELECT
        p.id AS catalog_product_id,
        p.sku AS catalog_sku,
        p.product_name AS catalog_product_name,

        sp.supplier_sku AS catalog_supplier_sku,
        sp.agreed_unit_price,
        sp.tolerance_percent,

        pa.alias_name,
        pa.normalized_alias,
        pa.confidence_score,

        CASE
            WHEN lower(trim(COALESCE(sp.supplier_sku, '')))
                 = lower(trim(i.invoice_supplier_sku))
            THEN 'EXACT_SUPPLIER_SKU'

            WHEN lower(trim(COALESCE(pa.normalized_alias, '')))
                 = lower(trim(i.invoice_description))
            THEN 'EXACT_ALIAS'

            ELSE NULL
        END AS catalog_match_method

    FROM invoice_input i

    JOIN public.products p
      ON p.organization_id = i.organization_id
     AND p.status = 'ACTIVE'

    LEFT JOIN public.supplier_products sp
      ON sp.product_id = p.id
     AND sp.organization_id = p.organization_id
     AND sp.supplier_id = i.supplier_id
     AND sp.status = 'ACTIVE'
     AND sp.effective_from <= i.invoice_date
     AND (
          sp.effective_to IS NULL
          OR sp.effective_to >= i.invoice_date
     )

    LEFT JOIN public.product_aliases pa
      ON pa.product_id = p.id
     AND pa.organization_id = p.organization_id
     AND pa.supplier_id = i.supplier_id
     AND pa.status = 'ACTIVE'

    WHERE
        lower(trim(COALESCE(sp.supplier_sku, '')))
            = lower(trim(i.invoice_supplier_sku))

        OR

        lower(trim(COALESCE(pa.normalized_alias, '')))
            = lower(trim(i.invoice_description))

    ORDER BY
        CASE
            WHEN lower(trim(COALESCE(sp.supplier_sku, '')))
                 = lower(trim(i.invoice_supplier_sku))
            THEN 1
            ELSE 2
        END,
        pa.confidence_score DESC NULLS LAST

    LIMIT 1
)

SELECT
    i.organization_id,
    i.supplier_id,
    i.purchase_order_id,
    i.invoice_date,

    i.invoice_id,
    i.invoice_item_id,

    i.invoice_line_number,
    i.invoice_supplier_sku,
    i.invoice_description,
    i.invoice_quantity,
    i.invoice_unit_price,
    i.invoice_line_total,

    cm.catalog_product_id,
    cm.catalog_sku,
    cm.catalog_product_name,
    cm.catalog_supplier_sku,
    cm.agreed_unit_price,
    cm.tolerance_percent,
    cm.alias_name,
    cm.normalized_alias,
    cm.confidence_score,

    COALESCE(
        cm.catalog_match_method,
        'NO_EXACT_CATALOG_MATCH'
    ) AS catalog_match_method,

    CASE
        WHEN cm.catalog_product_id IS NOT NULL
        THEN true
        ELSE false
    END AS catalog_product_found

FROM invoice_input i

LEFT JOIN catalog_match cm
    ON true;

    purchase_order_item_id,
    description_from_invoice,
    supplier_sku,
    invoiced_quantity,
    unit_price,
    discount,
    tax
)
VALUES (
    $1::uuid,
    $2::uuid,
    $3::integer,
    NULL,
    NULL,
    $4::text,
    $5::text,
    $6::numeric,
    $7::numeric,
    0,
    0
)

ON CONFLICT (invoice_id, line_number)

DO UPDATE SET
    updated_at = public.invoice_items.updated_at

RETURNING
    id AS invoice_item_id,
    invoice_id,
    organization_id,
    line_number AS invoice_line_number,
    product_id,
    purchase_order_item_id,
    description_from_invoice AS description,
    supplier_sku,
    invoiced_quantity AS quantity,
    unit_price,
    discount,
    tax,
    line_total,
    created_at,
    updated_at;

INSERT INTO public.anomalies (
    organization_id,
    invoice_id,
    invoice_item_id,
    supplier_id,
    product_id,
    purchase_order_id,
    anomaly_type,
    severity,
    status,
    expected_value,
    actual_value,
    variance_amount,
    variance_percent,
    estimated_financial_impact,
    description,
    evidence
)

SELECT
    $1::uuid,
    $2::uuid,
    $3::uuid,
    $4::uuid,

    NULL::uuid,

    $5::uuid,

    'UNKNOWN_PRODUCT',
    'HIGH',
    'OPEN',

    NULL::numeric,
    $9::numeric,
    NULL::numeric,
    NULL::numeric,

    $12::numeric,

    $11::text,

    jsonb_build_object(
        'invoice_line_number', $6::integer,
        'supplier_sku', $7::text,
        'invoice_description', $8::text,
        'invoice_quantity', $9::numeric,
        'invoice_unit_price', $10::numeric,
        'invoice_line_total', $12::numeric,
        'catalog_product_found', false,
        'catalog_match_method', $13::text,
        'best_candidate_product_id', $14::text,
        'best_candidate_sku', $15::text,
        'best_candidate_name', $16::text,
        'best_candidate_score', $17::numeric,
        'classification', $18::text,
        'requires_review', $19::boolean
    )

WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.anomalies a
    WHERE a.organization_id = $1::uuid
      AND a.invoice_id = $2::uuid
      AND a.invoice_item_id = $3::uuid
      AND a.anomaly_type = 'UNKNOWN_PRODUCT'
)

RETURNING
    id AS anomaly_id,
    organization_id,
    invoice_id,
    invoice_item_id,
    supplier_id,
    product_id,
    purchase_order_id,
    anomaly_type,
    severity,
    status,
    actual_value,
    estimated_financial_impact,
    description,
    evidence,
    detected_at;

    $1::uuid,

    'Review possible product match. Candidate product: ' ||
    COALESCE($4::text, 'Unknown') ||
    ' (' ||
    COALESCE($5::text, 'Unknown SKU') ||
    '). Match score: ' ||
    COALESCE($6::text, 'N/A') ||
    '.'

WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1

      AND ap.anomaly_id = $2::uuid
      AND ap.approval_type = 'ANOMALY_REVIEW'
      AND ap.status = 'PENDING'
)

RETURNING
    id AS approval_id,
    organization_id,
    anomaly_id,
    invoice_id,
    approval_type,
    status,
    requested_by,
    requested_at,
    decided_by,
    decided_at,
    decision_notes,
    expires_at;

SELECT
    EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM public.invoices existing
        WHERE existing.organization_id = $1::uuid
          AND existing.supplier_id = $2::uuid
          AND LOWER(TRIM(existing.invoice_number))
              = LOWER(TRIM($3::text))
    ) AS duplicate_invoice,

    (
        SELECT existing.id
        FROM public.invoices existing
        WHERE existing.organization_id = $1::uuid
          AND existing.supplier_id = $2::uuid
          AND LOWER(TRIM(existing.invoice_number))
              = LOWER(TRIM($3::text))
        ORDER BY existing.created_at DESC
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS existing_invoice_id,

    $1::uuid AS organization_id,
    $2::uuid AS supplier_id,
    $3::text AS invoice_number,

    $4::uuid AS purchase_order_id;

INSERT INTO public.anomalies (
    organization_id,
    invoice_id,
    invoice_item_id,
    supplier_id,
    product_id,
    purchase_order_id,

    anomaly_type,
    severity,
    status,

    estimated_financial_impact,

SELECT
    i.id AS invoice_id,
    i.organization_id,
    i.invoice_number,
    i.processing_status AS current_processing_status,

    COUNT(a.id) AS total_anomalies,

    COUNT(a.id) FILTER (
        WHERE a.status IN (
            'OPEN',
            'UNDER_REVIEW',
            'CONFIRMED'
        )
    ) AS active_anomalies,

    COUNT(a.id) FILTER (
        WHERE a.status IN (
            'OPEN',
            'UNDER_REVIEW',
            'CONFIRMED'
        )
        AND a.severity IN (
            'HIGH',
            'CRITICAL'
        )
    ) AS high_risk_anomalies,

    COALESCE(
        SUM(a.estimated_financial_impact) FILTER (
            WHERE a.status IN (
                'OPEN',
                'UNDER_REVIEW',
                'CONFIRMED'
            )
        ),
        0
    ) AS active_financial_exposure

FROM public.invoices i

LEFT JOIN public.anomalies a
    ON a.invoice_id = i.id
   AND a.organization_id = i.organization_id

WHERE i.id = $1::uuid
  AND i.organization_id = $2::uuid

GROUP BY
    i.id,
    i.organization_id,
    i.invoice_number,
    i.processing_status;

UPDATE public.invoices
SET
    processing_status =
        CASE
            WHEN $3::integer > 0
                THEN 'REVIEW_REQUIRED'
            ELSE 'PROCESSED'
        END,
    updated_at = NOW()

WHERE id = $1::uuid
  AND organization_id = $2::uuid

RETURNING
    id AS invoice_id,
    organization_id,
    invoice_number,
    processing_status,
    total,
    updated_at;
